description: This file defines React components for routing, including protected and public routes, using React Router. It manages user authentication state to conditionally render components or redirect users.

classes.name: ProtectedRoute
classes.description: A React component extending Route that renders a Redirect if the user is not authenticated, otherwise renders the intended route.

classes.name: AuthRoute
classes.description: A React component extending Route that renders the route if authenticated, otherwise redirects.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders either a Redirect or the Route component based on authentication status for ProtectedRoute and AuthRoute.

methods.name: Routes
methods.description: A React functional component that sets up application routes, fetching current user info on mount, and rendering routes for About and Home pages.
